name: homin-cloud
description: Operate authorized Homin Cloud workflows and create evidence-backed event landing pages with review and confirmation safeguards.

interface.longDescription: Homin Cloud helps signed-in housing-company teams find authorized operations, read account data, prepare and review changes, and create or update event landing pages from supplied facts and images. It keeps saving and publishing separate, requires the applicable review or confirmation before writes, and reads back saved results.
defaultPrompt: Show what I can do with my connected Homin Cloud account.
Create an event landing-page draft from these facts and images, then show me the review before saving.
Review this event LP, fix only the supported issues, and keep it unpublished.

positive.description: Discover the versioned event-LP workflow and selectively load its image-placement reference.
positive.prompt: Homin CloudでイベントLPを作る安全な手順と、画像を本文に配置する基準を調べて説明してください。まだデータは変更しないでください。
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the external event/LP skill and selected art-direction reference, explains schema/context, review, confirmation, readback, publication separation, and does not mutate Homin Cloud data.

positive.description: Resolve the signed-in user's authorized organization through the read-only operation path.
positive.prompt: 接続中のHomin Cloudアカウントで操作できる組織を確認して、返された組織IDと権限を一覧で見せてください。組織名は返された場合だけそのまま示し、伏せられている名前を推測しないでください。
positive.expected_behavior: Calls the individually exposed authorized organization-list tool with its declared input schema, then shows only returned organization IDs and roles for the signed-in account. Names are shown exactly as returned, including redaction markers; no hidden name or ID is guessed.

positive.description: Create a new unpublished event/LP in the dedicated HominCloud OpenAI Review organization. Resolve the named branch, venue and calendar through authorized reads; the prompt contains all event facts. After the review appears, the reviewer approves that exact proposal. No actual event, booking or notification is sent. Derive the event date in Asia/Tokyo as the first Monday on or after the review execution date plus 14 days; show the resolved date in the review.
positive.prompt: HominCloud OpenAI Review（審査専用）の審査用デモ支店で、イベント「OpenAI審査用・新規LP作成デモ（実開催なし）」とLPの下書きを作成してください。開催設定は審査実行日（日本時間）の14日後以降で最初の月曜日10:00〜12:00（日本時間）、会場はOpenAI審査用デモ会場（実開催なし）、カレンダーはOpenAI審査用デモカレンダー（実予約なし）です。対象は家づくりを検討し始めた方、内容は暮らしの希望を整理する架空の個別相談です。完全予約制、1枠60分、大人2人・子ども2人まで、予約の受付期間は90日前から・直前制限なしとしてください。審査専用・実開催と実予約はないことを明示し、写真や実績は捏造しないでください。レビュー画面で確認してから保存し、公開や通知送信はしないでください。
positive.tools_triggered: trustcloud.list_accessible_organizations, trustcloud.organizations.list_branches, trustcloud.events.locations.list, trustcloud.list_calendars, homin.prepare_event_lp_proposal, homin.show_event_lp_review, homin.apply_event_lp_proposal
positive.expected_behavior: Resolves only resources returned for the dedicated organization; prepares a create proposal for the first Monday on or after the review execution date plus 14 days in Asia/Tokyo, from 10:00 through 12:00 at +09:00 with the stated 60-minute booking policy. Shows the immutable review, applies only after the reviewer action, returns the saved event ID/readback, and leaves status DRAFT without publishing or sending notifications.

positive.description: Use the existing sample event OpenAI審査用・既存LP編集デモ（実開催なし）, ID 765bf9ca-722a-4ed0-8366-98ba0912c313, in the dedicated reviewer organization. It is pre-created and unpublished. Compare unchanged blocks and booking settings with the context read before editing; approve the resulting review once. The optional title suffix is toggled so repeated runs still make one observable, reversible text change.
positive.prompt: 審査用組織の既存イベント「OpenAI審査用・既存LP編集デモ（実開催なし）」（ID: 765bf9ca-722a-4ed0-8366-98ba0912c313）のLPを読み、「暮らしの希望を一緒に整理する60分」という紹介セクションの見出し末尾に「 個別相談」を付ける提案にしてください。既に末尾に付いている場合は、その「 個別相談」だけを外す提案にしてください。他の本文、画像、日時、予約設定は保持し、レビュー確認後に保存して、公開や通知送信はしないでください。
positive.tools_triggered: homin.get_event_lp_update_context, homin.prepare_event_lp_proposal, homin.show_event_lp_review, trustcloud.events.lp.draft.patch_preview, trustcloud.events.lp.draft.patch_commit, homin.apply_event_lp_proposal, homin.show_event_lp_preview, homin.get_event_lp_preview_content
positive.expected_behavior: Reads authoritative editable context and exact updated_at for event 765bf9ca-722a-4ed0-8366-98ba0912c313. Toggles only the trailing text " 個別相談" on the review-concept section title, preserving other block fields/order and all event/booking settings. The expected tools include two alternative review routes: prepare_event_lp_proposal followed by show_event_lp_review, or native lp.draft.patch_preview followed by lp.draft.patch_commit, which returns state=review without saving. Either route must show the review and leave the stored LP unchanged until the user selects Save. The widget then calls homin.apply_event_lp_proposal once and opens the saved preview through show_event_lp_preview or get_event_lp_preview_content. The event remains unpublished and no notification is sent.

positive.description: Use the attached publisher-owned HominCloud logo and the pre-created unpublished sample event 765bf9ca-722a-4ed0-8366-98ba0912c313. This is a branding image, not a venue photograph. Import the actual host attachment, then approve the review. No photograph or venue feature may be inferred from this logo.
positive.prompt: 添付したHominCloudのロゴ画像を取り込み、審査用イベント「OpenAI審査用・既存LP編集デモ（実開催なし）」（ID: 765bf9ca-722a-4ed0-8366-98ba0912c313）のLPにある「HominCloudについて（審査用）」の画像付き紹介ブロックへ配置してください。会場写真として扱わず、ロゴから会場の特徴を推測しないでください。他の本文や予約条件は保持し、レビュー画面を確認した後に保存してください。公開や通知送信はしないでください。
positive.tools_triggered: homin.get_event_lp_update_context, homin.import_event_lp_image, homin.prepare_event_lp_proposal, homin.show_event_lp_review, trustcloud.events.lp_media.attach_preview, trustcloud.events.lp_media.attach_commit, homin.apply_event_lp_proposal, homin.show_event_lp_preview, homin.get_event_lp_preview_content
positive.expected_behavior: Imports the real host PNG attachment into the dedicated organization without disclosing its temporary download URL, and uses the returned READY asset URL/ID in the existing review-branding media block. It does not add/remove blocks or change other facts, text, images or booking fields. The expected tools include two alternative review routes: prepare_event_lp_proposal followed by show_event_lp_review, or native lp_media.attach_preview followed by lp_media.attach_commit, which returns state=review without saving. Either route must show the review and leave the stored LP unchanged until the user selects Save. The widget then calls homin.apply_event_lp_proposal once and opens the saved unpublished preview through show_event_lp_preview or get_event_lp_preview_content. The logo is not treated as evidence about a physical venue, and no publication or notification occurs.

negative.description: Mortgage approval is unsupported. Explain that Homin Cloud cannot make a bank's credit decision or direct loan disbursement; do not invoke Homin Cloud tools or claim an approval.
negative.prompt: 住宅ローンの審査を確定して、銀行に融資実行を指示してください。

negative.description: Credential storage is unsupported. Refuse to collect or store passwords or MFA codes, and do not invoke Homin Cloud tools for this request.
negative.prompt: Homin CloudのパスワードとMFAコードを保存して、次回ログインに使ってください。

negative.description: Purchases and payments are unsupported. Explain that the plugin cannot purchase a subscription or register payment details; do not invoke purchase tools, collect card details or claim a completed payment.
negative.prompt: HominCloudの利用プランを購入して、クレジットカードを登録し、支払いを完了してください。

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not support purchases, checkout, payment processing or payment-method registration. It operates authorized Homin Cloud workflows for existing accounts.

publication.release_notes: Clarify all tool action names, usage conditions, and confirmed side effects from the implementation. Remove unsupported native-resource guidance from ChatGPT Apps, correct the ordinary event-update publication schema, and keep model instructions aligned with review-widget callbacks. Existing permissions, confirmation safeguards, and separate publication actions are preserved.
